question: Deba Prasad Das, Pankaj Charan Das and Gangadhar Pradhan are associated with which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Deba Prasad Das, Pankaj Charan Das, and Gangadhar Pradhan** are renowned figures associated with the **Odissi** dance form.
 
• **Odissi** is one of the classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha.
